module: Exports ribbon surfaces (splines) as a 16-bit PNG mask (GFXFormatR16) at the terrain grid size. Each texel is 65535 if its world center is inside a quadrilateral, 0 otherwise. Used by spline tools to make a mask usable by the terrain editor (painting). Requires a loaded terrain and the editor_terrainEditor extension.
notes: Without a terrain block or without the terrain editor, the function logs an error ('E') and exits without returning anything.
Iterates over every texel of the grid: high cost on large terrains.
The result is not returned: the success or failure of saveFile is only logged.

export.desc: Builds a kd-tree of the sources' quadrilaterals (enlarged by `margin`), rasterizes a bitmap of the terrain size and saves it as PNG.

filepath.desc: Path of the .png file to write.

sources.desc: Table of tables of quadrilaterals representing the ribbon surfaces.

margin.desc: Margin added around the quadrilaterals (0 by default), in meters (inferred from code).
